overview_description.description: Acacus Technologies is a leading mobility technology company headquartered in Dubai, UAE, founded in 2013. The company develops advanced artificial intelligence and machine learning-based solutions focused on transportation, fleet optimization, and autonomous mobility systems. Acacus is recognized as one of the pioneers of autonomous vehicle technology in the MENA region and successfully launched its first autonomous vehicle prototype in 2017. The company offers intelligent mobility platforms such as Lynx, Lynx Pro, and Lynx Vision, which help businesses optimize fleet utilization, automate dispatching, improve operational efficiency, monitor vehicle diagnostics, and enable real-time location tracking. Acacus also serves the aviation sector through its Peregrine electronic flight bag and crew operations management solution designed for airlines and flight operations.

about_short_description.short_description: Acacus Group is a technology company specializing in AI-powered fleet management and smart mobility solutions.

product.name: Intelligent Fleet Management
product.description: A solution integrating AI and machine learning to optimize fleet operations, reduce costs, and improve resource utilization.

product.name: Lynx
product.description: An intelligent fleet management system that tracks and optimizes vehicle operations using AI, providing alerts and diagnostics data.

product.name: Lynx Vision
product.description: A video analytics system for fleet vehicles, offering event recording, driver behavior monitoring, and cloud storage.

product.name: Lynx Pro
product.description: A tool for managing fleet disruptions, planning, and analytics, supporting various vehicle types and dispatching needs.

product.name: Autonomous Vehicles
product.description: Development and implementation of autonomous vehicle technology, including driverless patrol vehicles for Dubai Police.

product.name: Custom Water Cooling System
product.description: A cooling solution for Jetson boards in vehicles to prevent overheating in high temperatures.
